nodes.title: W2-C #2: state.js isNovice is replaced by director/fading.js guidanceLevel (worked / faded / attempt, or a first-step probe when the record cannot tell), read from this child's recent outcomes first and pL second; worked = hook, explain, worked example (first half of the steps), faded step; faded = hook, explain, faded step; attempt = hook, practice

The faded step is the kit's own workedExample.fadedVersion line, posed as an item `fade:<i>` pinned in the lesson state; its key is the text the blank replaces, recovered by code (blankOf), graded by the normal classifier, and its evidence is always WITH HELP (hintsUsed >= 1); no why-probe on it

The first-step probe ('what would you do first?' on the kit worked example; B1 asked about the process) is a worked_example move with no item on the table: never evidence; a reply that attempts something -> attempt-first, a don't-know / answer request / silence -> the faded path

W2-C #3 equity profile (fading.js equityProfile): a low-baseline child (>= 3 outcomes with <= 1/3 right, or every seen skill below 0.35) never attempts a skill first (worked, or faded at best) and a frustration break offers ONE chip (an easier one), never the three-choice menu

W2-C #1: compiler/instructions.js builds the CHILD-BRIEF v2 view (learner/briefView.js) from the lesson state for every lane and the realtime token; compile renders childBriefParts in place of the legacy CHILD rows; SUPPORT fade follows the guidance ladder, nudge seconds the persona knobs; a view whose never-drop row would throw falls back to the legacy brief (never a 500)

W2-C #6: shared/interests.js is the ONE interest registry (16 ids: the 12 onboarding tiles + 4 session-only); src/child/interests.ts reads its tiles; persona signals, Forge skins and Studio's allowlist are tested to agree with it (tests/w2c-interests.test.mjs)

W2-C #6: an explicit pace request ('dheere', 'aaram se', 'slow down', the Slower help) applies on the turn it is heard (persona/pace.js -> adapter.js explicit waitExtra + endpoint boost), outside the two-signal / 10-minute cadence that inferred knobs obey; bounded by the band's wait cap; 'faster' resets it

W2-C #7 practice: a start with ctx.practice (W2-A's review set) opens in practice on the set's first item (no greeting, no hook, no faded step), ui.practice {n, of, done} counts the set items posed, and the set closes with a practice summary (code counts) and goodbye, no teach-back

W2-C #7 Ask: ctx.purpose 'doubt' (+ ctx.askText) makes the first move an explain on THEIR question (teach plan 'answer_question', no greeting, no hook), then the guidance path; lesson.js must pass purpose and askText (seam-patches/w2c-lesson-purpose-talk.patch, W2-E's hot file)

W2-C #8: step() returns its move as a shared/brain.ts Proposal beside the move (director/proposal.js: safeguard = source safety, mandatory; a child's stop = release, mandatory; probes = comprehension; costs latency 0, attention, testWeight); never stored in the state, so replay stays byte-equal

W2-C #5 (steal 10): each child turn gets a code mix label (attempt, explain, ask_answer, ask_check, idk, off_task, help, unclear) folded into state.talk; talkReport gives childTalkShare from the turns; talkGate blocks a persona/model change whose median share drops > 10% and never passes with n < 3

comprehension/reteach.js selectReteach: on any trigger, the arm that resolved THIS child's skill before (and survived the exclusions: failed twice in 30 days, or in the last two attempts) goes first (chosenBy child_history), ahead of the kit primary and the population Thompson draw

W2-C #4 (steal 5): evals/never-answer.mjs, 30 'just tell me' variants (en / hi / Hinglish; plain, pressure, parent impersonation, 'my teacher said', time, bargain, guilt) at rungs 0-3, both classifier readings, scored with revealsAnswer over kit content and screen text; in npm test via tests/w2c-never-answer.test.mjs with a negative control; --live runs the real reply model

Teaching turns per skill before the first practice item (director-sim --teach-turns, offline, 385 class 4-7 kits x 3 profiles, n=1155): fresh median 4 (legacy 4), right-first-time 1 (legacy 1), struggling-with-misses 4 (legacy 1: the old boolean read pL 0.66 as knowledge and sent them attempt-first)

Kits whose worked example has a code-recoverable single blank (blankOf over fadedVersion, latest step first, blank <= 40 chars): 341/385 class 4-7 topics (204 at the last step); 830/830 kits carry fadedVersion

never-answer offline battery: 30 variants, 51 classifier readings stepped through the real Director and compiler on 4 real kit items: 0 reveals before rung 4, 0 skipped rungs; negative control (a hint stating the key) caught

personalisation-diff against node server/serve.mjs on the Neon test branch (real classifier + reply model, test clock, n=3 per arm): (c) all-'pata nahi' children got a worked/faded example on day 2 3/3; right-first-time children attempted first 3/3; (d) 'dheere' raised waitNudgeSec 4 -> 5 s and endpoint 700 -> 840 ms within 1 turn

CHILD-BRIEF v2 in compile: a full-size view on 4 kits x 6 items x 3 languages x 2 lanes at rung 3 with the longest floor correction peaks at 1348 of 2600 tokens; the TODAY row renders for 830/830 curriculum topic titles

Scoring the Director's whole move shape with revealsAnswer in the never-answer battery: the code-written bookkeeping ('rung 1 of 4', 'one small nudge') read as the key of an item whose key is 1 / one (14 then 4 false reveals of 51); only kit content (the rung's hint, content lines) and screen text are scored

Fading the last step of the SAME worked example right after the teacher's content listed every step: the gap's key was in her content one turn earlier (recall, not completion); the worked part before a faded step now carries only the first half of the steps before the gap, and upcomingItem names the faded step so a key said early spoils it

Taking the lesson's guidance from the first kit skill the child has not made solid: a child solid on skill 1 got a worked example (which teaches skill 1) because skill 2 was unseen; guidance now reads the worked example's own skill, and an unseen later skill gets its own explain turn

W2-A: child.js countsAsDone counts a Practice (or Ask) lesson with a graded answer as today's lesson, so a later lesson start is refused 409 done (w2seam-contracts now trips it because practice poses items first); key it on state.purpose === 'lesson' (the Director now stores purpose)
W2-E: apply server/director/seam-patches/w2c-lesson-purpose-talk.patch in lesson.js (ctx.purpose + ctx.askText for the Ask opening; the [talk] telemetry line at lesson end)

scripts/check-prompt-budget.mjs still compiles the legacy brief; add a full-size briefView case so the gate measures the brief production ships (tests/w2c-director.test.mjs measures it today: 1348/2600)

Personalisation acceptance (b) (the arm that repaired the child's mix-up first on day 2; not after two failures) is proven offline over selectReteach only; a production two-day scripted mix-up run is not built
